proposal.summary: WordPress Plugin Duplicator <= 1.4.7 discloses some system information via the 'view' parameter in the installer script main.installer.php.
proposal.cwe_quote: Some system information may be disclosure.

C.quote: Some system information may be disclosure.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Reproduce the issue by requesting main.installer.php with the 'view' parameter on an up-to-date test instance to capture the exact information disclosed and determine its sensitivity; then notify maintainers and prepare a patch to restrict access or sanitize output.
